subject: Recap + SOC2 packet — Q&A availability & timeline

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood-inference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-10-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + SOC2 packet — Q&A availability & timeline

Hi Samir,

Great to meet yesterday — thanks for the time. Quick recap from my side and the items we agreed on: 

- Use case: AuroraSoft wants to evaluate low-latency embeddings for search and a dedicated inference pool for PII-sensitive workloads.
- Priority: security review first (legal/security will sign off), then a short pilot (3–4 week).
- Success metrics: 95th percentile latency < 120ms at 4 concurrent sessions; embed cost target <$0.0008/embedding.

Next steps I promised to share: the SOC2 packet and a short checklist your security team can use while reviewing. Attached: Redwood_SOC2_Packet_v1.pdf (index + evidence links).

Can you confirm a tentative timeline from your side for security review? If it helps, Marissa (cc'd) can do a 20-minute walkthrough with your security or infra team to go through the packet and call out anything that commonly triggers follow-up items.

Proposed slots (PDT): Tue 10/05 10:00–10:20, Wed 10/06 14:00–14:20, Thu 10/07 09:00–09:20. If none of these work, send a couple windows that do.

Thanks — happy to adjust based on your internal process.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Packet_v1.pdf (pdf, 2.9MB)
From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@aurorasoft.com>

Date: 2027-10-04T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + SOC2 packet — Q&A availability & timeline

Thanks Chloe — received the packet and forwarded to our security team (cc: Priya). We expect to review this week; I should have a clearer timeline by end of next week.

If they have questions, I’ll route them to you/Marissa for a short Q&A. For now let’s tentatively hold Wed 10/06 14:00. I’ll confirm or propose a different slot once I hear back.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Samir
Samir Shah
Head of Platform | AuroraSoft
samir.shah@aurorasoft.com

Subject: Checking in — SOC2 packet review / blockers?

Samir / Priya —

Following up on the SOC2 packet I shared — just checking whether your security team has any blockers or open questions we can help clear quickly. A 15–20 minute sync usually answers most evidence/timing questions and prevents back-and-forth.

If it’s helpful, Marissa can run the walkthrough and highlight the typical evidence artifacts and where they live (audit logs, retention policy, vendor assessments). Suggested short agenda: 1) quick index review (5 min), 2) evidence mapping (7–10 min), 3) next steps & timeline (3–5 min).

Proposed slots (PDT): Thu 10/07 09:00–09:20 (today), Fri 10/08 11:00–11:20, Mon 10/11 15:00–15:20. If you’re not the right person to set the meeting, please let me know who owns SOC2 reviews and I’ll route directly.

Also — is this still a priority this month from AuroraSoft’s side, or should we reprioritize for later? Any update helps us plan a pilot readiness window.

Thanks,
Chloe

Samir / Priya —

Wanted to bump this thread briefly — haven’t seen a time selected for the walkthrough and I wanted to confirm whether anything is blocking you from reviewing the SOC2 packet. If helpful I can:

- Share a short one-pager that maps the packet contents to the specific AuroraSoft checklist items (I can send this by EOD).
- Lock a firm 15-minute QA with Marissa to answer technical questions live.

If this is no longer a priority for October, please let me know and I’ll pause outreach. Otherwise, can you confirm one of these options (one-pager / quick call) by end of day?
